subject: English
title: CISCE curriculum: English, Class VIII

source.read: A third-party copy of the Class VIII pages of the CISCE curriculum (English: printed pages 23 to 30), hosted by BYJU'S
source.note: UNOFFICIAL SOURCE. The pages do not name their publisher or year, and were read through a text summary of the PDF, not the PDF itself. The official document on cisce.org could not be reached from the build environment. CISCE is understood not to prescribe a textbook for this class, so a school's own book and term plan may order or extend these topics.

licence: Strand names as printed (facts). Every outcome is written by OpenPath in its own words with a pointer to its strand and line; no curriculum text is reproduced.
review: OpenPath curriculum inventory (research from a secondary source; not an educator review)

outcomes.text: Finds a text's central theme and follows how it develops.
outcomes.note: The main idea and the writer's argument are taught; following a theme through a long text is not yet.

outcomes.text: Uses evidence from the text to support views on character and plot.
outcomes.note: Ordinary reading checks require a separately scored sentence selection. Level 4 character and plot views use curated supporting combinations, including Joel’s honesty and how returning the money changes the Night Market story. This covers selecting textual support, not writing a literary essay.
